# David Packer Recommends Training Front Lever Three To Four Times Per Week

David Packer recommends training front lever three to four times per week, as he responded extremely well to doing it very often. [src: vid-lkcLJc2c0NQ]

## Details

- When doing only two times per week for front lever, you have to do a ton of volume; it is better to be very specific and train the pools 15 to 20 reps per session three times per week or four. [src: vid-lkcLJc2c0NQ]

## Evidence

- vid-lkcLJc2c0NQ (David Packer): "well i'll say front lever i think front leave a minimum of like three three to four times a week it really res well i responded extremely well to doing it like very often"
- vid-lkcLJc2c0NQ (David Packer): "when you do only two times per week for the front lever you really have to do a ton of volume you know you do yeah yeah just a ton and it's better to just be very specific train the pools 15 to 20 reps per session three times per week four maybe and that's it"
